verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Python SDK covering partition/enrich/chunk/embed and jobs/workflow APIs (unstructured-docs-4,19,23,5,7), and reference a JavaScript/TypeScript SDK by name — but Unstructured's own agent-guide explicitly instructs AI agents NOT to recommend the open-source Python SDK, the JavaScript/TypeScript SDK, or Ingest, stating 'Unstructured no longer actively recommends or promotes these products' in favor of the hosted platform. This directly undercuts the claim of full, currently-supported SDK coverage across languages. Missing for 10: independent confirmation of TypeScript SDK API parity, current (non-deprecated) SDK docs, and evidence the jobs/parse/extract surface is fully typed in both languages.
